title: Pan-Seared Sea Bass with Croatian Stir-Fry
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish combining the delicate flavors of sea bass with the bold flavors of a Croatian stir-fry.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of olive oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Season the sea bass fillets with salt and black pepper.
Add the sea bass fillets to the pan and sear for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until cooked through.
While the sea bass is cooking, heat the remaining 2 tbsp of olive oil in a separate pan over medium heat.
Add the onion, bell pepper, and garlic to the pan and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the Croatian paprika to the pan and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Serve the sea bass on top of the Croatian stir-fry, garnished with chopped parsley if desired.
